methodology_other: Quarterly monitoring against Child Protection indicators in north east Nigeria
name: social-economic-reintegration-reach-borno-and-adamawa-states-north-east-nigeria-quarter-1-2019
notes: The zipped geometrical dataset contains a shapefile on the reach of social-economic assistance to children and adolescents who have suffered from grave child rights violations, including former children associated with armed groups (CAAG) in Borno and Adamawa States. The provision of socio-economic reintegration support to children and adolescents is one of the indicators upon which the Child Protection in Emergencies Working Group is directing its humanitarian response efforts in response to the crisis north east Nigeria.
